title: feat(builtin-deps): Add builtin dependencies manifest syntax
body:
*[View all comments](https://triagebot.infra.rust-lang.org/gh-comments/rust-lang/cargo/pull/17498)*

### What does this PR try to resolve?

As part of https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/issues/16960, this PR adds the required syntax to the manifest to specify builtin dependencies. The main validation present in this PR is that `builtin = true` being present anywhere requires the `builtin-dependencies` feature in order to avoid accidentally introducing any new stable behaviour in later PRs. Invalid forms of builtin dependencies are rejected in a later PR. For now builtin dependencies panic with a `todo!()` as there is no `SourceKind` variant to represent them.

This PR is part of a chain:
- https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/pull/17497
- https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/pull/17502
- https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/pull/17498
- https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/pull/17499
- https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/pull/17500

### How to test and review this PR?

The PR first introduces the manifest syntax, then builds on that by adding various tests that `builtin = true` requires an unstable feature. Cargo test passes on every commit.

🤖 LLM disclosure: I used Codex to help me understand the codebase and asked it to review my branch before sharing it upstream. I also used it in limited (pre-arranged) ways to generate code, including resolving merge conflicts and updating test assertions. All code was originally written by hand.
